answer: Correlation-taxed bonds: each agent posts a bond, and every epoch the network compares pairs of agents by answer embeddings, submit timing and funding paths. Clones run by one operator bend together like trees in one gale, so pairs above a similarity threshold split a single reward and forfeit part of both bonds. An honest agent stands out like an opal in basalt and keeps full pay, while a farm of N copies posts N bonds for one share, so splitting identities is a net loss.
